versions.changelog:
- Clarified and expanded the description in SKILL.md to specify exactly when and why this skill should be applied.
- Emphasized that all AGENTS.md root index sections are required, highlighting which are most valuable for AI guidance.
- Strengthened recommendations for using explicit, mandatory index files and providing module dependency and modification-risk documentation.
- Updated usage triggers to cover more scenarios, including retrofitting or restructuring projects for AI navigation.
- Made language stronger and more prescriptive about always using the skill when AI-focused structure or navigation is requested.

- Removed redundant README.md file to simplify documentation.
- SKILL.md is now the primary and only documentation file.
- No changes to functionality or skill description; content and guidance remain unchanged.

Initial release introducing project structure guidance for AI agents.

- Implements a 4-level index architecture (AGENTS.md, INDEX.md, file headers, inline comments) for progressive disclosure and efficient AI navigation.
- Provides detailed templates and best practices for AGENTS.md and module-level INDEX.md files.
- Covers when and when not to apply the methodology, including project size guidance.
- Focuses on navigation efficiency, safe code modification, and intent-oriented project indexing.
- Includes cross-cutting pattern documentation and dependency mapping to maximize AI comprehension across various languages.
